rules.prepare: # The configure script of the release is used as it is. One that is made # again outside of upstream's git repository calls the version # "1.61-unknown" and a beta (autogen.sh --find-version). Debian patches # that away and has the revision count the lines of its changelog. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" $AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-languages \ --disable-nls \ --disable-doc \ --disable-tests \ --disable-rpath \ --enable-shared \ --enable-static
